headline: Brent Crude Tops $99 Amid Fresh Strait of Hormuz Tanker Disruptions
summary: Crude oil futures surged as Brent topped $99 and WTI neared $92 per barrel after fresh maritime security concerns and attacks in the Strait of Hormuz disrupted oil transport.
why: Geopolitical disruptions in key global transit chokepoints directly threaten petroleum supplies, driving up energy commodity prices and shipping costs.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Brent crude topped $99 per barrel due to fresh maritime security incidents in the Strait of Hormuz.
